DLSS 5: Modders Push Leaked Neural Rendering Into 10+ More PC Games
I tried NVIDIA's DLSS 5 before its official release—it's incredible
items.content:
Credit: Nick Lewis / How-To Geek By Nick Lewis Published Aug 29, 2026, 2:30 PM EDT Nick Lewis is an editor at How-To Geek. He has been using computers for 20 years --- tinkering with everything from the UI to the Windows registry to device firmware. Before How-To Geek, he used Python and C++ as a freelance programmer. In college, Nick made extensive use of Fortran while pursuing a physics degree. Nick's love of tinkering with computers extends beyond work. He has been running video game servers from home for more than 10 years using Windows, Ubuntu, or Raspberry Pi OS. He also uses Proxmox to self-host a variety of services, including a Jellyfin Media Server, an Airsonic music server, a handful of game servers, NextCloud, and two Windows virtual machines. He enjoys DIY projects, especially if they involve technology. He regularly repairs and repurposes old computers and hardware for whatever new project is at hand. He has designed crossovers for homemade speakers all the way from the basic design to the PCB. Nick enjoys the outdoors. When he isn't working on a computer or DIY project, he is most likely to be found camping, backpacking, or canoeing. Sign in to your How-To Geek account Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google News Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap DLSS 5 isn't due for an official release until sometime later this year, but an unfinished version that slipped out with NBA 2K27 has allowed the RenoDX modding community to get it running with dozens of games.

I spent an evening trying it out on as many games as possible, including one from 2003. Even in its unfinished state, DLSS 5 is impressive.

window.arrayOfGalleries["article-gallery-1-74788297"] = '" "'; The DLSS 5 reads scene semantics—things like skin, hair, and fabric—and adds lighting and material detail that the engine never actually rendered.

DLSS 5's output is based on the game's actual geometry and motion vectors, so you aren't flooded with the weird hallucinations that are often common in AI-generated video.

The result is nearly photorealistic gameplay that doesn't reduce your gameplay to single-digit FPS.

window.arrayOfGalleries["article-gallery-2-1550035634"] = '" "'; In Cyberpunk 2077, DLSS 5 makes skin, wet streets, and neon light interactions appear almost like something out of a film. It also does wonders for the random NPCs you encounter as you move through Night City.

NPCs that were previously dull and forgettable pick up an exceptional amount of detail in their faces and clothing. I could imagine a well-framed screenshot passing as a photograph.

Close window.arrayOfGalleries["article-gallery-3-1013184628"] = '" Close "'; The environment in Baldur's Gate 3 didn't seem to benefit from DLSS 5 as much as games like Cyberpunk 2077 or Grand Theft Auto V did. There were even a few unique bugs, like glowing butterflies.

window.arrayOfGalleries["article-gallery-4-135500030"] = '" "'; However, where DLSS 5 does shine is the characters. It does a good job changing the appearance of the characters without losing the qualities that define them. I was concerned that non-human characters like Lae'zel would become human-looking, but DLSS 5 actually handled it quite well. The human characters all looked great.

window.arrayOfGalleries["article-gallery-5-1872813537"] = '" "'; However, Baldur's Gate 3 also has a lot of fantastical elements that DLSS 5 just doesn't seem to address.

This accidental release isn't perfect. In my testing, I noticed that some objects are shimmering or flickering when they shouldn't, and faces sometimes do subtly shift, which is more than a little creepy.

The broader issue is how similar everything looks. Photorealism is a fine look for some games, like Cyberpunk, Death Stranding 2, and Grand Theft Auto V, but it is often conspicuously out of place in games like Baldur's Gate 3.

NVIDIA has stated that there will be tools that give developers control over intensity, color grading, and masking. That is certainly a step in the right direction, but highly-stylized genres will only benefit if developers (or players) get the ability to tweak the DLSS 5's art style more specifically.

Credit: NVIDIA Critics of DLSS 5 have been quick to point out that this technology often produces results that are firmly in uncanny valley territory. Some of the faces it creates are just subtly wrong in a way that is unsettling. It's a valid complaint for now, but if history can teach us anything, it's that DLSS 5 won't remain uncanny for long.

After giving us plenty of insight on how the RPG will run on Nintendo's system, we got a little update on that coveted physical release - though it's not very exciting, I'm afraid.

CD Projekt tucked the little titbit into the back half of a dedicated presentation during the third day of the event. "The news will come when the time is right," the panel says , in response to a question about getting the game in tangible form.

Told you it wasn't very exciting. But such is the process of making physical games. They're collector's items now, and not entirely intended for mass production, and the company ducked out on going the game card route for Cyberpunk 2077. Most of the people who pick up The Witcher 3 Remastered on the latest Nintendo platform will be doing so digitally anyway, since this is how audiences have shifted.

Watch On I'm sure there are plenty of people internally at CD Projekt Red who advocate for owning games on discs and cartridges, but this is a game that's been out for over a decade now. Putting it on physical media on yet another platform just won't be top of the to-do list.

It's good to hear the possibility wasn't shot down - I would expect we'll hear something within a relatively short amount of time of Geralt of Rivia making his way onto the hybrid console. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered comes out on Switch September 29, which would make Christmas a sound window to get some cases and carts into stores.

The Witcher 3 Remastered is free for existing owners, but here's the cheapest way to get a copy if you're yet to dive in CD Projekt Red snuck 30 improvements into The Witcher 3 Remastered reveal The Witcher 3's new Songs of the Past expansion was dead at CD Projekt Red for years, dev says Despite the RPG's age, this is just one of several ways CD Projekt Red is continuing to support it. There's brand new DLC coming next year, Songs of the Past , and that'll help link this installment up to The Witcher 4 . Geralt's got plenty of work ahead of him, to say the least.

items.title: CD Projekt Red has The Witcher 4 running on all target platforms after Cyberpunk 2077 lesson
items.summary: Game Developer spoke to CD Projekt Red co-CEO Michal Nowakowski

Cyberpunk 2077 was a lesson for CD Projekt Red. After its disastrous launch and subsequent removal from the PlayStation Store, developer CD Projekt Red now makes sure that its games are working on all platforms throughout development, co-CEO Michal Nowakowski told Game Developer.

"You come to the studio, you launch Witcher 4 right now," Nowakowski said. "You can launch it on PC. You can launch it on PS5. You can launch it on Xbox Series X, and it's going to run."

That's in contrast to how Cyberpunk 2077 worked its way through development—the whole thing was PC-driven, Nowakowski said. "The way the studio was thinking was that we are reaching for the best possible visuals," he said. "We want to push the boundaries of what is doable in terms of cinematic feeling and whatnot, and PC was just the best suited rig for that. There was this, as it turned out, false belief that toning it down to whatever was the current gen is not going to be that much of a challenge."

Related: Opinion: Deprofessionalization could foster toxic work environments on small teams

Nowakowski said CD Projekt Red faced this sort of challenge with The Witcher 3 , but "got a bit lucky here and there," which made the studio feel like Cyberpunk 2077 would end up fine, too. "Since then, we don't take chances," he said. "We want to be sure that it actually works."

If something's wrong with The Witcher 4 on a single platform, the developer stops to fix everything until they're sure of the problem. It means the milestone process for the game is a little different. "For example, technically, we should hit, let's say, 10 checkmarks," he posited. "Back in the past, if we missed one or two, we were like, 'we're gonna catch up with that later on.' Sometimes we did, but sometimes we didn't, and then two milestones or three milestones down the road, you have like four or five missing checkmarks and it's not that easy."

Speaking about the newly announced The Witcher 3 expansion and remaster, Nowakowski said CD Projekt Red is working with a company called Geeksoft, based in Hungary, because of their extensive knowledge of The Witcher 3 's engine—Red Engine. Nowakowski said that the Red Engine used for Cyberpunk 2077 is not the same as it was when used for The Witcher 3 , and revisiting that can be challenging. Geeksoft comes from the modding community, and have "been very active in the world of the Witcher," he said. The company hired them to help with The Witcher 3 's modding tools release. It made sense for them to sign back on for CD Projekt Red's return to that world.

Nowakowski didn't want to give much detail on the future for CD Projekt Red, but said the company will share more about the mysterious Project Hadar "at some point," perhaps, in the next five years. For now, it's back to the task at hand: The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 .

New Commodore 64 Includes an 8-Bit Cyberpunk 2077 Demo
items.summary: The new Commodore 64 variant features a Night City-inspired translucent case, enhanced FPGA hardware, and an exclusive 8-bit Cyberpunk 2077 demo.
items.content:
The new Commodore 64 variant features a Night City-inspired translucent case, enhanced FPGA hardware, and an exclusive 8-bit Cyberpunk 2077 demo.

Commodore and CD Projekt Red have unveiled the Commodore 77 , a new Cyberpunk 2077-inspired version of the Commodore 64 Ultimate that includes an exclusive 8-bit journey through Night City.

At first glance, the accompanying software looks like an official Commodore 64 demake of Cyberpunk 2077. It is not quite a playable adaptation of the enormous open-world RPG, however. Commodore describes it as a non-interactive demo: a carefully choreographed audio-visual experience designed to expand the universe’s lore while showing how far modern creators can push technology based on a computer released in 1982.

The demo was created by Arise, a long-running Polish Commodore 64 group, with an original soundtrack from chiptune musician LukHash. His 2021 album CyberChip was composed and recorded entirely using original Commodore 64 hardware.

Rather than distributing the experience through an ordinary download, Commodore 77 owners will receive it on a specially designed Arasaka cartridge resembling the data shards found throughout Cyberpunk 2077. It will be exclusive to the system.

The demo makes use of capabilities that extend beyond those of a conventional Commodore 64, including 24 channels of stereo SID music and a 2MB cartridge chip containing its code. LEDs built into the computer’s base will illuminate and move in time with the presentation.

The hardware itself has also been designed to resemble something that might appear on a desk somewhere in Night City. It features a smoked-gray translucent case, turquoise lighting, graffiti graphics, a metallic plate, a neon power indicator, and a custom Cyberpunk 2077-themed BASIC 2.0 startup screen.

“The tech in Cyberpunk 2077 is chunky, tactile, and substantial—meaning that the Commodore 77 can really feel like a device lifted straight out of the game world and onto your desktop,” CD Projekt Red Franchise Content Strategy Lead Patrick Mills said.

Additional extras include collectible packaging, stickers, pins, custom menu colors, and a Cyberpunk-themed spiral-bound user guide. That manual will contain pieces of lore alongside BASIC programs owners can type into the computer themselves.

Beneath the cosmetic changes is an enhanced version of the FPGA hardware used by the Commodore 64 Ultimate. FPGA-based recreations reproduce the original computer’s underlying hardware behavior instead of simply running its software through a conventional emulator.

The Commodore 77 uses an AMD Artix XC7A100T processor, an upgrade over the 50T chip inside the standard Commodore 64 Ultimate. Commodore says it will reach speeds of 77MHz, compared to the approximately 1MHz processor used by the original C64.

Despite that additional power, the computer remains compatible with more than 99.9% of the library of over 10,000 Commodore 64 games and peripherals. Owners can therefore use both original and newly created software, as well as many surviving physical accessories from the classic platform.

The system is available to pre-order for $377 and is expected to begin shipping in early 2027. Yes, that's pretty much exactly 50-years before the game's setting. Nice.

The announcement arrives alongside another major celebration of Commodore gaming history. Commodore, Team17, and Antstream Arcade have also announced the Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection , bringing six games originally released for Commodore hardware to current PCs and consoles. The new collection launches on September 24 for PC, PlayStation, and Xbox, with a Switch version coming later this year.

items.title: M6 To Offer Double The M4’s Gaming Performance In Cyberpunk 2077, Hinting At A Massive Uplift, And With Negligible Compromises On Visual Settings
items.summary: Apple M6 chip leaks suggest a massive 2x GPU boost over M4 running Cyberpunk 2077 with ray tracing enabled at Ultra visual settings
items.content:
Apple has finally lifted the veil off the M6 and Mac mini refresh , and for those who are particularly excited about how the company’s first 2nm chipset will perform in games, there’s a brief teaser that the technology giant shared on one of its product pages. Apparently, the M6 offers double the gaming performance in Cyberpunk 2077 compared to the M4. What’s also important to note is that while Apple Silicon isn’t notable for running these titles at exceptionally high visual settings, you might be surprised with what you’re about to read.

With its 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU, the M6 is expected to ensure that you experience a bump in compute and graphics performance According to the graph shared by Apple below, Cyberpunk 2077 performs twice as fast as on the M4, but here’s the part that surprised us the most While you can check out the test system and visual settings below, the M6 managed to achieve this feat with ray tracing enabled, one of the most demanding features in a AAA game

The game was also tested at the “Ultra” settings preset, with MetalFX set to balanced and resolution set at 2,048 x 1,152. However, it’s unconfirmed if the latter is the upscaled resolution or the base resolution. What Apple also conveniently forgot to mention is the framerate, but we’re confident that when the first review units are sent out, we’ll find out those metrics soon enough. Still, those who were criticizing Apple for not speeding up in the gaming department might have to eat their words soon.

“Testing conducted by Apple in July 2026 using preproduction Mac mini systems with Apple M6, 12-core CPU, and 12-core GPU, and production Mac mini systems with Apple M4, 10-core CPU, and 10-core GPU, both configured with 32GB of unified memory and 2TB SSD. Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition performance tested at 2048x1152 resolution, with ultra preset, MetalFX set to balanced, and Ray Tracing on. Mac mini systems tested with an attached 5K display. Performance tests are conducted using specific computer systems and reflect the approximate performance of Mac mini.”

We should also mention that Cyberpunk 2077 can be played with Path Tracing enabled on a Mac, but it’s fair to assume that the M6 would almost immediately fall to its knees trying to render those realistic lighting effects, so it was probably for good reason why it wasn’t included in the test. If you want to become one of the early adopters, Amazon is taking pre-orders for the M6 Mac mini, starting from $899 for the base model , with all configurations offering a 12-core CPU and a 12-core GPU.

The version with 16GB of unified memory paired with 512GB storage is listed for $1,099 , while the top-end configuration featuring 24GB of unified memory and a 512GB SSD is going for $1,299 .

About the author : Omar Sohail is a reporter and analyst for Wccftech's mobile section, specializing in the technology and business of the mobile industry. His expertise lies in the intricate hardware supply chain, covering developments in semiconductor manufacturing, chip lithography, and camera sensor technology.

items.title: A day and a night in Cyberpunk 2077
The 8 Most Perfect Games Like Cyberpunk 2077
items.summary: Strategic takedowns, heartbreak, fighting for calm amid the bleakest settings...these are just a few elements these eight games share.
items.content:
on Google Preferred Source Google News Link copied to clipboard By Rebecca Corgan Published Aug 12, 2026, 12:30 PM EDT Polygon Lists Noir detectives and dystopian bartenders abound.

Cyberpunk 2077 is a game about a lot of things, but isolation and self-discovery are major themes. Image: CD Projekt Red via Polygon Sign in to your Polygon.com account Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google News Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread 1 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Night City won’t let go of you easily. Nor is Cyberpunk 2077 a game you’ll soon forget. The neon and chrome aesthetic, the pervading corporate rot, and V’s Keanu-Reeves-assisted identity crisis are more than enough to build a dystopia that sticks in your mind. Once you’ve left it, you might even miss it.

If you’re experiencing post- Cyberpunk 2077 blues, you’re in the right place. Its developer, CD Projekt Red , did not invent dystopian neon, and there are many titles out there that either show up in full cyberpunk gear or have a similar feel – including these eight games like Cyberpunk 2077 . Some are closer to Night City than others. All are full of bad systems, worse people, and reasons to keep playing anyway.

Eidos Montreal/Square Enix What you’ll like about it : It’s rife with corporate conspiracies, it grapples with augmentation ethics, and it’s got a body arguing with its owner, too.

In Deus Ex: Mankind Divided , set in the far-off future year 2029, Adam Jensen is thrown into a mission to stop a group of rogue arms dealers from selling weapons and augmentations. Unfortunately, that mission doesn’t end well, thanks to a band of murderous mercenaries in creepy gold masks who crash the deal and turn the whole thing into a firefight.

There’s the Illuminati. There’s also an underground hacker group. And there’s Prague, where you’ll spend your time ducking through subway stations, sneaking into corporate offices, and wondering which conspiracy is actually the conspiracy you need to focus on. You start the game in an abandoned Dubai luxury resort…during a sandstorm. As your character learns that terrorist groups are purposely performing violent acts to keep the human race divided and scared, you’ll need to decide: What, if anything, can Jensen do to keep society together when the augmented terrorists have very different plans?

Image: Ubisoft Toronto/Ubisoft via Polygon What you’ll like about it : Here, you’ve got the control and paranoia, just not the RPG.

Where to play : PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X

A mysterious group, Zero Day, has just framed the resistance hacker syndicate DedSec for lethal bombings in London. DedSec’s got to clear its name, then rebuild itself from the ground up. Unfortunately, London is now in an authoritarian surveillance state, and DedSec is public enemy number one. Time to go talk to your fellow citizens to see if you can free your city.

That concept of nameless citizens banding together to save London defines the game, including character creation: Instead of being Cyberpunk 2077 ’s V, a character with a defined spot in the story, Watch Dogs: Legion casts you as anyone. In both games, you’ll use hacking skills, stealth, and gunplay. But only in Watch Dogs: Legion can you recruit basically anybody on the street, then send your brand-new spy into combat with an invisible spy car.

Image: CD Projekt Red via Polygon What you’ll like about it : It’s got similar no-clean-choices bones, but in a fantasy skin.

Where to play : PC, PS4, PS5, Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt ’s main story follows a mutant monster hunter, Geralt of Rivia, as he looks for his daughter, Ciri. She’s on the run because she has powers that the Wild Hunt, a ghostly army, desperately wants. Will Geralt find Ciri before the Wild Hunt does? Luckily, his ex, the sorceress Yennefer, is ready to help…

This clearly is not a genre match for Cyberpunk 2077 , as a medieval fantasy instead of a futuristic dystopia. But both were created by the same developer, CD Projekt Red – and both feature dark stories and complex scheming behind the scenes. Do you prefer traveling by horse or motorcycle? Feel better wielding a firearm or sword? You don’t have to choose. Playing both is a great way to discover that CD Projekt Red considers “good choice” a deeply negotiable concept.

items.content:
Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live!

This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below:

Vehicles

  • Updated AutoDrive. When driving to a selected point, the vehicle now drives smoothly, overtakes blocking vehicles and no longer stops at traffic lights. Free Roam mode has also been upgraded to follow traffic rules and navigate the city more reliably.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Johnny always spawned in the passenger seat when using the Delamain Cab service.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where applying CrystalCoat to the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru caused its wheels to flash in different colors.

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Most of the new poses introduced in Update 2.3 now work with any gender.

    [/*]

  • Disabled NPC collision, which will make it easier to position NPCs on top of other objects with collision (e.g. on car hoods).

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where some of the poses didn't work for Royce.

    [/*]

Quests & Open World

  • Freedom - Fixed the journal entry that appears when the player chooses not to steal the Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred."

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where, after V fails to pursue and stop Semimaru and receives a text from River saying he'll contact V soon, the follow-up message never arrives.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where the Yaiba Semimaru could flip over during the chase, preventing the player from entering it.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - It's no longer possible to trigger the quest if River died during The Hunt.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Players can now acquire the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru through AUTOFIXER even if they failed The Hunt, which normally unlocks the side quest where the vehicle is obtained.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed a game crash that could occur in certain circumstances after leaving the Yaiba showroom event.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed an issue where the proxy interface UI in the Yaiba showroom is cut off when the "Larger HUD Elements" setting is enabled.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Fixed several localization and lipsync issues in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle to disable vignette. It can be found in Settings → Graphics → Basic.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on PC and Mac where Ray-Traced Reflections might not display correctly when enabled under certain conditions.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several issues with displaying text messages from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Various fixes for fluff vendors.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Fixed an issue where NVIDIA Reflex could be disabled while DLSS Frame Generation was enabled, causing the screen to turn pink.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Path Tracing didn't activate properly in certain scenarios.

    [/*]

Mac-specific

  • Fixed an issue where changing graphics presets on Mac set Screen Space Reflections to a higher setting compared to the equivalent presets on PC.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing a permanent white screen when Frame Generation is enabled while entering the braindance in The Information.

    [/*]

  • Selecting "Defaults" in Video Settings no longer turns HDR Mode off.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where setting the MetalFX DRS Maximum Resolution above the value applied by the “For this Mac” preset could cause visual artifacts.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the inverted behavior of the "Mute Game in Background" toggle in Settings.

    [/*]

  • Removed the outdated "(Requires Game Restart)" disclaimer from the mouseover description of the "Disable Spatial Audio" setting.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on the App Store version that caused the game to become stuck on the “Press Space to continue” breaching screen.

    [/*]

  • Various stability and performance optimizations.

    [/*]

items.content:
Surviving the City of Dreams is tough, but a choom at your side can make all the difference.

In our latest It’s All About You episode, we’re celebrating all of our iconic duos living on the edge! Night City wouldn’t shine quite so bright without them. 

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners in the most creative ways possible. Don't forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY. See you in the next episode!

items.title: Update 2.3 Patch Notes
items.summary: Update 2.3 lands tomorrow! Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as sup
items.content:
Update 2.3 lands tomorrow!

Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as support for AMD FSR 3.1 Frame Generation, Intel XeSS 2.0 and HDR10+ Gaming, among others.

Update 2.3 also brings Cyberpunk 2077 to a whole new platform: Mac with Apple silicon! If you already own the game on Steam, you can play it on your compatible device. To find out whether your Mac can run Cyberpunk 2077, please check the official requirements.

Read the list of changes for more info:

Vehicles

  • Added 4 new vehicles, including several Side Jobs tied to acquiring them:

    • Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Hunt and The Beast In Me).

      An additional side job unlocks the CrystalCoat™ feature for it.

      [/*]

    • Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred"

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Beast in Me: Badlands, The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo, Transmission, and Search and Destroy)."

      [/*]

    • Yaiba ASM-R250 Muramasa

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, purchase 1 Yaiba vehicle, purchase at least 3 vehicles through AUTOFIXER, and complete Reported Crime: You Play with Fire...).

      If you fail the side job, the vehicle can later be purchased through AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]

    • Chevillon Legatus 450 Aquila

      Available for purchase on AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Introducing AutoDrive! This cutting-edge, autonomous driving feature will take you to your chosen destination (i.e. job objective or placed pin on the map). If you have no set destination, it will take you on a leisurely ride through the streets of Night City. Simply hop in any of your vehicles, make sure you're on a road, and hold G (PC) / Left Stick (consoles) to activate. This feature is disabled when you enter combat or when your vehicle is heavily damaged.

    [/*]

  • Implemented Cinematic Camera for AutoDrive. Hold Q (PC) / D-Pad Right (consoles) to activate. Sit back and enjoy cinematic views of Night City as you cruise toward your destination.

    [/*]

  • Self-driving Delamain cabs are now available on demand! Simply open the menu to call vehicles, then select "Delamain Cab" from the list to request a ride. This feature unlocks after completing the job Don't Lose Your Mind (regardless of outcome) and receiving a message from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ is now available for vehicles from partner brands, including motorcycles. Additionally, the infamous hacker known as Cosmetic_Troll exploited a vulnerability and created a cracked version of Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ technology for lower-end vehicles. Please note, however, that some models do not support the technology, such as heavily modded nomad vehicles and job-related vehicles.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color schemes did not work properly on the Mizutani Shion MZ1 and MZ2.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color scheme could not be applied properly to the Villefort Deleon "Vindicator".

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Added 27 new NPCs that can be spawned in Photo Mode, including Rita Wheeler, the Cassel twins, fixers, Dum Dum, the iguana, Brendan, and more.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between alternative outfits for NPCs spawned in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between V's saved Wardrobe outfits in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • Added a confirmation pop-up when exiting Photo Mode to prevent accidental exits after setting up the perfect shot.

    [/*]

  • Added more customization options to the Look-At Camera feature, including an option for only the character's eyes to turn toward the camera instead of their entire body.

    [/*]

  • Added improvements to Lighting:

    • Lights now spawn around the camera instead of the player character.

      [/*]

    • Added an outline to the spotlight mesh and an indicator when it's off screen for better visibility.

      [/*]

    • Improved light movement speed on controllers.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Added multiple new stickers and frames, including iconic quotes and stylish overlays that let you turn your screenshots into Night City postcards – perfect for sharing memories from the City of Dreams.

    [/*]

  • Improved Depth of Field and moved it to the Camera tab.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Color Balance tab, allowing you to create your own custom filters.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Time and Weather tab:

    • Weather: includes rain, acid rain, fog, sandstorm, pollution, and sunny.

      [/*]

    • Time of Day: changes the time of day within Photo Mode.

      [/*]

    • Frame Forward: advances through an unlimited amount of frames to capture the perfect shot.

      [/*]

    • Game Speed: allows in-game time to progress while in Photo Mode."

      [/*]
    [/*]

Quality of Life & Accessibility

  • The game will now detect if the player is using inverted mouse button settings and automatically adjusts in-game button prompts accordingly.

    [/*]

  • Added an option to toggle aiming down sights in Settings → Controls.

    [/*]

Jobs & Open World

  • Cyberpsycho Sighting: Bloody Ritual - the "Crack the ritualist's shard" objective now properly disappears from the Journal after completing the objective.

    [/*]

  • Sex on Wheels - now properly appears in the Journal after receiving the message from Jake Estevez.

    [/*]

  • Shot by Both Sides - fixed an issue where selecting a specific dialogue option in the conversation with Bree created a nameless, iconless item in the player's Inventory.

    [/*]

  • Shot by Both Sides - fixed an issue where the button to go to the lower level didn't appear on the elevator panel.

    [/*]

Gameplay

  • Fixed an issue where, when using a controller in Trauma Drama, the controllable character would default to shooting upwards instead of forward.

    [/*]

  • Players can now drop more Cyberware Capacity Shards if some within the intended drop limit were previously missed.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing automatic weapons to fire slower than intended.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the Official BARGHEST Tac Vest didn't drop from the scripted Airdrop as intended.

    [/*]

  • The level 60 Engineer perk no longer activates the EMP blast outside of combat or after entering a vehicle.

    [/*]

  • Added an option to replay the gameplay tutorial at any time via Settings → Controls.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Added an option to tell Johnny to go away after you look at him for a short while when he appears in the passenger seat. He takes the hint and disappears as a passenger for a couple days.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the sound of V's Radioport could be randomly interrupted by the Radioports of nearby NPCs.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where History by Gazelle Twin and Trash Generation played too loudly compared to other songs on the radio.

    [/*]

  • Improved the HDR Setting screen: fixed the HDR calibration preview so it correctly reflects the chosen settings, and clarified the description of the "Tone-Mapping Midpoint" setting.

    [/*]

  • Updated the End User Licence Agreement. You will be asked to accept it again when you load the game after updating.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several visual issues with missing, clipping, or floating textures.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several localization issues in various languages.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Added support for AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 4 for compatible AMD GPUs. IMPORTANT: The FSR 4 option will not be available in the in-game settings until the supporting AMD driver is installed. Please note that the driver will be released at a later date.

    [/*]

  • Added support for AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution Frame Generation 3.1 for compatible hardware. It can now be used in combination with any upscaler.

    [/*]

  • Added support for ​Intel XeSS 2.0, with XeSS Frame Generation available on compatible hardware.

    [/*]

  • Added support for HDR10+ GAMING certified Intel GPUs. To enable this feature, your display must support the technology (find my display) and have "Game Mode" enabled. The HDR10+ GAMING toggle can be found in Settings in the Video tab.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the DLSS Super Resolution Preset would invisibly revert from the CNN model to the Transformer model after restarting the game, even though the UI still displayed the CNN model as active.

    [/*]

  • Added more detailed information to the DLSS Super Resolution Preset tooltip in Settings to help players choose the best option for their setup.

    [/*]

  • Added the ability to move the mouse cursor to a different display while in Windowed Borderless mode.

    [/*]

  • Increased the maximum save size from 12 MB to 15 MB.

    [/*]

  • It will now be possible to rebind the key used to jump out of vehicles with the Stuntjock perk.

    [/*]
